t: This is Aldermanbury, a street in the City of London. Two people who died here are worth knowing. Mahomet Weyonomon was a chief of the Mohegan tribe from Connecticut. He travelled to England in 1735 to petition King George the Second for better treatment of his people, and he died on this street. Francis Le Piper, also known as Lepipre, was an English artist of Flemish ancestry, and he too died here.
